title: Chonky Cat Waddled into Steam Next Fest
author: jiltedgenerationprod

comments.author: jiltedgenerationprod
comments.body:
Chonky Cat is taking part in Steam Next Fest! Check out the Demo: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4380420/Chonky\_Cat\_Demo/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4380420/Chonky_Cat_Demo/)

AI has partially been used to help with the creation of the intro song, some art and 3D meshes.

Become the fluffiest menace in Chonky Cat, play as a massively overfed cat on a never ending binge. Chase, crush, and devour waves of creatures to grow even fatter and more unstoppable. Eat everything, unlock upgrades, multipliers and customizations and see just how chonky you can get!

AI has partially been used to help with the creation of the intro song, some art and 3D meshes.

comments.body: Too many really cool hand crafted games in the Fest to waste time on this slop goat simulator rip-off

replies.author: aigamedev-ModTeam
replies.body: Be respectful. Removed for AI Art or Artist bashing.

comments.author: Ok_Potential359
comments.body: This is hilarious and very well done honestly. What did engine did you use? Which AI? How long did this take you?

replies.author: jiltedgenerationprod
replies.body: Thanks, I used unreal engine, i used midjourney for some of the 2d art, [meshy.ai](http://meshy.ai) for a 3d model and suno for the intro song

replies.author: Recoil42
replies.body:
You killed it with the art direction. 

Curious how meshy was for model generation. Did you compare it to tripo at all?

replies.author: jiltedgenerationprod
replies.body: Thanks, i found meshy very good, especially this newer model, i used it a couple of times in the past and it wasn't as good but it is constantly getting better. I used rodin also in past and another one, it could of been tripo but i found meshy the best so used that when i needed a model created for this project.

replies.author: Ok_Potential359
replies.body:
Did you have experience in development before? This is fairly polished TBH. 

What was the total cost would you estimate?

replies.author: jiltedgenerationprod
replies.body:
Thanks, yeah i do a bit, i spent a few years developing Slaughter Cats (on unity and unreal engine) which i didn't end up releasing (too big, maybe one day), then i created unreal physics kind of a free tech demo game thing and then Only Way is Down was my first commercially released game last year.

I've spent around a $1,000 on hiring someone to do the music and maybe a few hundred on assets and subscriptions and a few hundred on marketing thus far (will likely be a few thousand by the time it releases). My time is obviously free but it would be in the $10,000s if i was to pay myself a decent wage.

replies.author: Ok_Potential359
replies.body: Great information. I don't think people realize you can just prompt something like this overnight so glad to hear something more grounded.
